# x402 Services Directory

> Live directory of x402-paid API services. Each service was probed for a real 402
> payment challenge at generation time. Data regenerated every 6 hours from public
> facilitator discovery endpoints.

Machine-readable listing: services.json (array of service objects with url, host,
price in USDC, network, payTo address, and gate-check verdict).

Consume: fetch /services.json; filter services where challengePresent == true.
